result.summary: The page mostly looks fine; one minor visual inconsistency was found in the heart/favorite icon styling between cards.

issues.description: The favorite heart icon on the 'Tokumaru Ramen Bar' card has a white circular background while the same icon on the pizza card below has a dark/transparent circular background, creating inconsistent styling across similar cards.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite icon's background style (color/opacity) across all restaurant cards for visual consistency.
